sections.coverage: All theorem hypotheses, regularity exponents, normalization, frozen operators and example class.
Weak formulation, function spaces, Hardy/Sobolev scales, source-space extension and interior endpoint.
Three frozen comparison estimates and Morrey iteration; actual affine counterexample.
Locally frozen barriers, bounded forcing, closeness, relative Campanato iteration and main regularity dependency.
Normalized barriers, Hopf comparison and boundary positivity.
Homogeneous frozen operators and quotient regularity; weaker target exponent retained.
Green existence dependencies, upper/lower comparisons, Poisson normalization and gradient restrictions.

limitations: Cited external papers not all read or reproved.
No numerical PDE simulation; counterevidence is analytic with exact symbolic auxiliaries.
Full repair of the core Campanato and lower Green proofs not certified.
No counterexample to the original weighted-source main theorems established.
Subscription journal text not compared with bound preprint.
